<div class="zt-widget">
  <svg
    class="zt-svg"
    viewBox="0 0 881 620"
    preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    role="img"
    aria-label="Zona de Tanques Línea número 2"
  >
    <defs>

      <!-- Metal satinado -->

      <linearGradient
        id="zt-metal-gradient"
        x1="0%" y1="0%"
        x2="0%" y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ECEEF0" />
        <stop offset="16%" stop-color="#E2E4E7" />
        <stop offset="46%" class="zt-metal-stop" />
        <stop offset="62%" stop-color="#E2E3E6" />
        <stop offset="84%" class="zt-metal-stop" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C6C8CD" />
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- Interior azul -->

      <linearGradient
        id="zt-liquid-gradient"
        x1="0%" y1="0%"
        x2="0%" y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#B4DCEF" />
        <stop offset="30%" class="zt-liquid-stop" />
        <stop offset="72%" class="zt-liquid-stop" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#92C3DE" />
      </linearGradient>

      <pattern
        id="zt-liquid-pattern"
        width="12"
        height="6"
        patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
      >
        <path
          class="zt-wave"
          d="M 0 3 Q 3 0.5 6 3 T 12 3"
        />
      </pattern>

      <!-- Sombra ambiental y de contacto -->

      <filter
        id="zt-equipment-shadow"
        x="-20%" y="-20%"
        width="140%" height="150%"
        color-interpolation-filters="sRGB"
      >
        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="2"
          result="ambientBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="ambientBlur"
          dx="0" dy="2.5"
          result="ambientOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#18212D"
          flood-opacity="0.10"
          result="ambientColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="ambientColor"
          in2="ambientOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="ambientShadow"
        />

        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="0.5"
          result="contactBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="contactBlur"
          dx="0" dy="0.8"
          result="contactOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#111820"
          flood-opacity="0.15"
          result="contactColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="contactColor"
          in2="contactOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="contactShadow"
        />

        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="ambientShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="contactShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
        </feMerge>
      </filter>

      <!-- Flecha pequeña de sentido de circulación -->

      <marker
        id="zt-flow-arrow"
        viewBox="0 0 6 6"
        refX="5.5"
        refY="3"
        markerWidth="5"
        markerHeight="5"
        markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
        orient="auto"
      >
        <path class="zt-flow-arrow" d="M 0 0 L 6 3 L 0 6 Z" />
      </marker>

      <!-- Válvula vertical: extremos en y = -10 y +10 -->

      <g id="zt-valve-v">
        <path
          class="zt-valve-body"
          d="M -10 -10 H 10 L 0 0 Z"
        />
        <path
          class="zt-valve-body"
          d="M -10 10 H 10 L 0 0 Z"
        />
      </g>

      <!-- Válvula horizontal: extremos en x = -10 y +10 -->

      <g id="zt-valve-h">
        <use href="#zt-valve-v" transform="rotate(90)" />
      </g>

      <!-- Símbolo circular de línea -->

      <g id="zt-inline-symbol">
        <circle class="zt-inline-body" cx="0" cy="0" r="10" />
        <path
          class="zt-inline-sector"
          d="M -5 -8.66 A 10 10 0 0 0 5 8.66 Z"
        />
      </g>

      <!-- Bomba horizontal compacta -->

      <g id="zt-pump-compact">
        <rect
          class="zt-pump-body"
          x="-18" y="-10"
          width="36" height="20"
          rx="1"
        />
        <path
          class="zt-pump-detail zt-pump-red"
          d="
            M -14 -10 V 10
            M 14 -10 V 10
            M -10 -6 H 10
            M -10 0 H 10
            M -10 6 H 10
          "
        />
        <path class="zt-highlight" d="M -11 -8 H 11" />
      </g>

      <!-- Interiores de los tanques con margen de 4 unidades -->

      <path
        id="zt-mix-inner"
        d="
          M 154 404
          H 280
          V 503.2
          L 218 525.7
          L 154 504.2
          Z
        "
      />

          M 598 402
